name: Your Company
tagline: A desk, a private room or an office for your team — from tomorrow and without a long lease
niche: Coworking and serviced offices in central Tashkent

listing.description: A website for a coworking space, business centre or IT hub. A product-style bento grid with live widgets: a clock, “open now”, a WebGL colour field and tiles that light up under the cursor.

seo.title: Your Company — coworking and offices in central Tashkent
seo.description: Hot desks, dedicated desks, offices for 2–20 people and meeting rooms on Amir Temur Street. 24/7 access, gigabit internet, contracts from one day.
seo.answer: Your Company is a coworking space at 107B Amir Temur Street in Tashkent with 24/7 access. A day pass is 120,000 sum, a hot desk 1,400,000 sum per month, a dedicated desk 2,100,000 sum, an office for 4 from 7,800,000 sum per month. Meeting rooms can be booked by the hour from 150,000 sum.

sections.title: Work where you think best
sections.subtitle: Three floors of desks, private rooms and meeting rooms in central Tashkent. Face-ID access, gigabit internet, unlimited coffee and a contract even for a single day.

sections.label: Spaces
sections.title: Choose how you work
sections.intro: Every format includes internet, coffee and tea, printing up to 100 pages a month and access to the kitchen and terrace.

items.title: Team office
items.text: A private room for 2–20 people with furniture, a whiteboard and its own lock. Bring your own equipment and branding.

items.title: Dedicated desk
items.text: Your own desk with a drawer unit in the open hall: your monitor and things stay in place.

items.title: Hot desk
items.text: Any free desk in the open hall or quiet zone.

items.title: Meeting rooms
items.text: Rooms for 4, 8 and 16 people with a screen, camera and whiteboard wall.

items.title: Phone booths
items.text: Six soundproof booths for calls — free for members.

items.title: Event hall
items.text: Up to 80 guests: meetups, lectures, presentations. Projector, sound and coffee break on request.

sections.label: About the hub
sections.title: An office without the hassle of a lease
sections.text: Your Company opened in 2023 in a business centre on Amir Temur. We take care of everything that distracts from work: cleaning, internet, security, coffee, reception and a registered address. Members are startup teams, freelancers, representative offices of foreign companies and studios.

sections.label: Moving in
sections.title: From tour to your first working day

items.title: Tour
items.text: Drop by for 15 minutes: we’ll show you the floors, meeting rooms and free offices.

items.title: Choose a format
items.text: We’ll match a desk or office to your team size and budget.

items.title: Contract online
items.text: Signed electronically, paid by card or bank transfer.

items.title: Access
items.text: We register your face in the access system — you can start tomorrow.

items.name: Day pass
features: Meeting room — at the hourly rate

items.quote: Our team of eight moved in within two days: signed online and were working the next morning.
items.author: Dilshod

items.quote: I take day passes when it’s noisy at home. The quiet zone really is quiet.
items.author: Madina

items.quote: I needed a registered address and an office to meet clients — this place has both.
items.author: Abror

items.q: Can I come for just one day?
items.a: Yes, a day pass is 120,000 sum: any free desk, internet, coffee and tea. Just message us on Telegram or come to reception.

items.q: Are you open at night and on weekends?
items.a: Members get in 24/7 with their pass. Reception works daily from 08:00 to 22:00.

items.q: Can I register my company at your address?
items.a: Yes, a registered address is included in the Dedicated desk and Office plans; for others it’s a separate service.

items.q: What is the minimum contract term?
items.a: One day for a day pass, one month for desks and offices. 10% off when paying for six months.
Yes, the business centre’s underground car park — with a pass; the first 2 hours are free for guests.

sections.label: Contacts
sections.title: Come for a tour
sections.text: We’ll show you the floors in 15 minutes and find you a spot. Tell us when suits you — we reply within an hour.
